name: One Resource, Start to Finish: A Practical Guide for ESL/EFL Teachers
description_short: A practical guide for independent ESL/EFL teachers who want to develop, check and prepare their own teaching resources: thirteen stages from deciding what you are making to release, with a checklist at each stage and a one-page release checklist. One downloadable PDF, 60 pages, US$4.99 on Payhip. No workbook, templates, prompt collection or worked example.
creator: GapTheMind
gtmk_relationship: GapTheMind paid resource, sold through Payhip
internal_notes: Teaching guide rather than a classroom activity. Age, level and activity duration are not specified.
